exposure: Second-generation long-acting injectable antipsychotics (aripiprazole, risperidone, paliperidone, olanzapine)
cohort: Pregnant women of any trimester, identified from a global network of 148 healthcare organizations within the TriNetX database.
finding: No significant differences were observed in the composite primary endpoint of obstetric complications (gestational diabetes, preeclampsia, eclampsia, or newly diagnosed hypertensive disorder) between women exposed to long-acting injectable and oral second-generation antipsychotics.
mod_finding: No difference in cesarean section rates was observed between women receiving long-acting injectable and oral second-generation antipsychotics.
